data.title: Sexual Assault Lawyer Philadelphia: David P. Thiruselvam of the Victims’ Recovery Law Center Fights for Survivors' Civil Rights
data.description:
PHILADELPHIA, PA / ACCESS Newswire / October 23, 2026 / David P. Thiruselvam, sexual assault lawyer in Philadelphia and founder of the Victims' Recovery Law Center, is reminding survivors of sexual violence throughout Philadelphia that their legal options extend far beyond the criminal justice system. As a Philadelphia sexual assault attorney, David P. Thiruselvam represents survivors in civil claims against perpetrators, institutions, employers and property owners, without requiring any police report, criminal prosecution or conviction.

For many survivors, the decision whether to report a sexual assault to law enforcement is deeply personal. Civil litigation removes that requirement. A civil claim for sexual assault in Philadelphia is filed by the survivor directly, is governed by a lower standard of proof than criminal court and can result in significant financial compensation for medical costs, therapy, lost income, pain and suffering and emotional distress. A rape victim lawyer in Philadelphia can pursue these claims regardless of whether criminal charges were ever filed.

The Victims' Recovery Law Center's civil practice for sexual assault survivors is built around a core principle: the perpetrator is often not the only party with legal responsibility. Institutions, employers, property owners and organizations whose negligence created the conditions for the assault can be named as defendants in a Philadelphia sexual assault civil case. These institutional defendants carry commercial liability insurance, making them the most viable path to meaningful financial recovery for survivors.

"Survivors of sexual violence in Philadelphia often feel that the civil justice system is closed to them if the criminal case fell apart," said David P. Thiruselvam. "As a sexual assault lawyer in Philadelphia, I want every survivor to know that the civil path is open regardless of what the criminal system did or did not do."

All consultations at the Victims' Recovery Law Center are confidential. The firm handles all sexual assault civil cases on a contingency fee basis, meaning survivors pay nothing unless the firm recovers compensation on their behalf.

About the Victims' Recovery Law Center

The Victims' Recovery Law Center, led by Philadelphia sexual assault attorney and shooting victim lawyer David P. Thiruselvam, is a Pennsylvania-based civil litigation firm dedicated exclusively to representing survivors of gun violence, sexual assault, rape, child abuse and other violent crimes. David P. Thiruselvam is a member of the Million Dollar Advocates Forum and the Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum and is licensed in Pennsylvania, New York and New Jersey. The firm serves clients throughout Philadelphia and the greater Pennsylvania area. Survivors can reach the firm at 215-546-1433 or victimrecoverylaw.com.

data.title: GA-ASI Partnering With Spirit Defense For FQ-42 CCA Production
data.description:
SAN DIEGO, CA / ACCESS Newswire / October 23, 2026 / General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI), the world leader in Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), today is announcing our partnership with Spirit Defense, a Boeing Company, to support airframe production of the new FQ-42 Vengeance Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA). In June, GA-ASI won a contract from the U.S. Air Force (USAF) to produce FQ-42. Spirit Defense's role as a fuselage design-build partner brings together the company's engineering and advanced manufacturing capabilities to support the program from design through production.

GA-ASI has been the sole manufacturer of its line of UAS - which includes MQ-9A Reaper®, MQ-1C Gray Eagle®, MQ-20 Avenger®, and MQ-9B SkyGuardian®/SeaGuardian - since the company's inception in 1992. For the FQ-42 program, partnering with Spirit Defense is a strength multiplier for the company and the nation, offering manufacturing capacity and industrial depth to scale CCA production faster, while strengthening production resilience, and reducing the risk of single points of failure.

"We're excited to be working with Spirit Defense," said GA-ASI President David R. Alexander. "We've established our proven design, development, and manufacturing capability for the FQ-42. With Spirit Defense we add capacity, which is exactly the kind of production resilience our U.S. Air Force customer is looking for with its CCA ramp-up. This kind of partnership represents the scalable industrial base the Air Force and the U.S. Department of War are looking for from industry."

"We're proud to bring deep manufacturing expertise and proven capabilities to this important program," said Keith Schrader, president and CEO of Spirit Defense. "Our team understands the responsibility that comes with supporting critical national defense programs, and we're ready to deliver for our customer and the warfighter."

FQ-42 is a purpose-built, uncrewed fighter, developed with USAF as part of ongoing investment in next-generation semi-autonomous combat aircraft. The jet's modular design enables rapid integration of mission systems and mission autonomy software. GA-ASI's software architecture, demonstrated through live flight tests on multiple airframes, provides the foundation for human-machine teaming in complex combat scenarios.

Potential CCA manufacturing partnerships don't end here. Around the world, GA-ASI is in discussions with numerous international militaries interested in our Gambit Series of modular CCAs. The Gambit Series is a family of uncrewed combat jets, derived from our work on FQ-42, XQ-67A Off-Board Sensing Station, and MQ-20 Avenger, and optimized for roles such as electronic warfare, suppression of enemy air defenses (SEAD), Destruction of Enemy Air Defenses (DEAD) and stand-off precision strike, making it a versatile option for evolving security needs.

Nations interested in procuring aircraft from the Gambit Series also have an opportunity to insert indigenous manufacturing into those programs, as well as integration of their own sensors, weapons and other combat technologies.

About Spirit Defense

Spirit Defense, a Boeing Company, is an independent supplier to the defense industry. Headquartered in Wichita, Kansas, the company provides engineering, design-build, manufacturing, and lifecycle support for defense programs. Leveraging more than a century of aircraft design and manufacturing experience, Spirit Defense helps customers move innovative concepts from development to production through rapid prototyping, scalable manufacturing, and proven aerospace expertise.

About GA-ASI

General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc., is the world's foremost builder of Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS). Logging more than 9 million flight hours, the Predator® line of UAS has flown for over 30 years and includes MQ-9A Reaper®, MQ-1C Gray Eagle®, MQ-20 Avenger®, MQ-9B SkyGuardian®/SeaGuardian®, XQ-67A, and FQ-42 Vengeance. The company is dedicated to providing long-endurance, multi-mission solutions that deliver persistent situational awareness and rapid strike.

For more information, visit www.ga-asi.com.

data.title: American Express to Cut 5% of Global Workforce — 3rd Update
data.description:
By Kelly Cloonan 




  American Express plans to cut about 5% of its global workforce, a move the company said is aimed at reducing layers and speeding up decision making. 



  The layoff plans came as the credit-card company reported higher third-quarter profit and revenue as its customers continue to spend more. The results prompted the company to raise its profit outlook for the year. 



  The stock declined 3.3% to $314.57 on Friday. Shares are down 15% this year. 



  The job cuts will affect roughly 3,500 roles, American Express said. 



  Chief Executive Stephen Squeri said the move aims to streamline the company's teams to align on key focus areas, boost efficiency and invest further in its priorities, like adding more perks for its cardmembers. 



  "We've got good momentum, but to accelerate innovation and win over the next few years, we needed to become a more agile and efficient organization," Squeri said during a call with analysts. 



  American Express now forecasts earnings per share of $18.30 to $18.60 for the full year, up from $17.30 to $17.90 previously. The new outlook factors in a boost from the sale of the company's equity investment in Global Business Travel Group, part of which it is reinvesting in the restructuring plan. 



  The company expects adjusted earnings per share--which exclude the effects of the sale and restructuring--of $17.60 to $17.90, and said it remains on track for sales growth of 10% this year. 



  Analysts polled by FactSet project earnings of $17.61 a share on revenue growth of 10% for the year. 



  Squeri attributed the guidance raise to the company's performance so far this year. 



  American Express, which targets higher-income consumers, is seeing strength in billings as it acquires new customers and retains its existing card members, he said, and as it continues to improve its membership model. 



  The company has been investing further in its roster of membership credit cards that come with annual fees and a range of perks. For instance its Platinum card, which was refreshed last year, comes with access to premium travel perks like airport lounges and luxury hotel benefits. 



  Going forward, Squeri said American Express aims to improve the customer experience with the help of artificial intelligence. For example, the company is looking to use the technology to offer customers more personalized experiences in areas like its restaurant partnerships, which give certain cardmembers access to sought-after reservations and other perks. 



  "AI gives us the opportunity to take our value propositions much further," Squeri said. 



  Third-quarter profit was $3.71 billion, or $5.42 a share, compared with $2.9 billion, or $4.14 a share, a year earlier. 



  Adjusted earnings per share were $4.68, compared with analyst estimates of $4.48, according to FactSet. 



  Revenue net of interest expense rose 9% to $20.06 billion. Analysts forecast revenue of $20.12 billion. 



  The increase in sales was primarily due to higher card-member spending, higher net interest income on growth in card balances, and card fee growth, American Express said. 





  Write to Kelly Cloonan at kelly.cloonan@wsj.com 





  (END) Dow Jones Newswires

data.title: Elektros Opens a New Chapter: Exploring American Lithium Potential and the Road Ahead
data.description:
WEST PALM BEACH, FL / ACCESS Newswire / October 23, 2026 / ELEKTROS Inc. (OTC PINK:ELEK) (the "Company") is entering a new day with a renewed focus on identifying opportunities that could shape its long-term direction. From preliminary lithium prospects in northern New York to possible connections between Sierra Leone lithium logistics and U.S. refining, ELEKTROS is evaluating where disciplined research, capable partners and practical execution may intersect.

Looking North: An American Lithium Possibility

A central area of interest is the potential for lithium-bearing properties in northern New York State near the Canadian border. ELEKTROS is considering the strategic merits of this region as part of its broader interest in U.S.-based lithium opportunities. This review is early-stage: the Company has not announced a property acquisition, mineral rights, a compliant resource or reserve, verified grades, a development plan or production at any New York location.

Connecting the Pieces of a Lithium Strategy

Beyond domestic evaluation, the Company continues to examine logistics associated with lithium in Sierra Leone and potential introductions to U.S. refining facilities. The objective is to understand possible routes from material sourcing to processing, along with the commercial, regulatory and financial requirements that would need to be satisfied. No definitive refinery arrangement or shipment commitment is being announced here.

Innovation Beyond the Mine

ELEKTROS is also exploring potential ELEKTROS-branded EV fast-charging sites and routes to commercialize its Multi-Port Charging Assembly for Electric Vehicles, protected by U.S. Patent No. 12,522,100 B1. Discussions about sites, prototype development and possible commercialization remain exploratory; no signed charging partnership, patent license or patent sale is announced in this release.

Market Attention, Long-Term Discipline

The Company previously reported a 51.52% daily advance in ELEK shares for the trading day referenced in its October 22, 2026 announcement, based on its review of Bloomberg stock quotes and Yahoo Finance. That historical observation is not a statement about trading on October 23, 2026 or an indication of future performance. Management remains focused on the work required to turn promising ideas into verifiable milestones.

The Work Ahead

ELEKTROS intends to assess possible opportunities through property access, geological review, permitting, processing options, infrastructure, capital requirements and commercial feasibility. The Company has not announced government grants, defense contracts or definitive transactions related to the initiatives described above. Future announcements, if any, will depend on actual progress and the availability of information suitable for public disclosure.

A Message from Leadership

"We are approaching this next chapter with energy and a clear sense of responsibility," said Shlomo Bleier, Chief Executive Officer of ELEKTROS Inc. "We see reasons to explore, ask better questions and build relationships, but we know that real progress must be demonstrated through action. Our commitment is to keep working diligently and communicate with shareholders as meaningful developments occur."

data.title: AM Best Revises Outlooks to Stable for Members of Coverys Companies
data.description:
AM Best Revises Outlooks to Stable for Members of Coverys Companies

AM Best has revised the outlooks to stable from negative and affirmed the Financial Strength Rating (FSR) of A (Excellent) and the Long-Term Issuer Credit Ratings (Long-Term ICR) of “a” (Excellent) of Medical Professional Mutual Insurance Company (Boston, MA) and its rating unit members, collectively known as Coverys Companies (Coverys). (See below for a detailed list of these subsidiaries and Credit Ratings [ratings]).

The ratings reflect Coverys’ balance sheet strength, which AM Best assesses as very strong, as well as its adequate operating performance, neutral business profile and appropriate enterprise risk management (ERM).

The revision of the outlooks to stable reflects Coverys’ improved operating results in recent years and through the first half of 2026, as well as the forward-looking expectation for the group’s performance to be roughly in line with peers assessed at adequate within the medical professional liability (MPL) composite. While underwriting results continue to be impacted by challenging market conditions within the MPL segment, consistent and growing net investment income has enabled Coverys to produce positive pretax earnings in the three most recent years and through the first half of 2026. Significant amounts of realized capital gains in most recent years have further contributed to overall earnings. As such, overall operating ratios and return metrics have demonstrated improvement.

Coverys continues to maintain the strongest level of risk-adjusted capitalization, as measured by Best’s Capital Adequacy Ratio (BCAR). Through its improved results, the group has managed to grow its surplus in the three most recent years and through the first half of 2026. However, persistent adverse prior-year loss reserve development in recent years contributed toward AM Best lowering the balance sheet strength assessment from strongest to very strong. AM Best will continue to monitor Coverys’ loss reserves and developments.

The neutral business profile assessment reflects Coverys’ solid position within the U.S. MPL segment as the seventh largest writer based on 2025, direct premiums written. Management is focused on improving its core U.S. MPL book while diversifying its business across the health care space through expanding its accident & health lines of business, as well as its international MPL presence. Strengthened leadership across the organization in recent years provide support for the group’s current and future operations. ERM continues to be viewed as appropriate, with a developed framework in place and risk management capabilities close in line with the organization’s risk profile.

The FSR of A (Excellent) and the Long-Term ICRs of “a” (Excellent) have been affirmed with the outlooks revised to stable from negative for the following members of the Coverys companies rating unit:

  • Medical Professional Mutual Insurance Company
  • ProSelect Insurance Company
  • Preferred Professional Insurance Company
  • Coverys Specialty Insurance Company
  • Coverys Risk Retention Group, Inc.
  • Coverys Limited
  • Coverys International Insurance Company Designated Activity Company

This press release relates to Credit Ratings that have been published on AM Best’s website. For all rating information relating to the release and pertinent disclosures, including details of the office responsible for issuing each of the individual ratings referenced in this release, please see AM Best’s Recent Rating Activity web page. For additional information regarding the use and limitations of Credit Rating opinions, please view Guide to Best's Credit Ratings. For information on the proper use of Best’s Credit Ratings, Best’s Performance Assessments, Best’s Preliminary Credit Assessments and AM Best press releases, please view Guide to Proper Use of Best’s Ratings & Assessments.

AM Best is a global credit rating agency, news publisher and data analytics provider specializing in the insurance industry. Headquartered in the United States, the company does business in over 100 countries with regional offices in London, Amsterdam, Dubai, Hong Kong, Singapore and Mexico City. data.title: Union Home Mortgage unveils AI and automation advancements during 2026 Annual Partner Celebration
data.description:
Union Home Mortgage unveils AI and automation advancements during 2026 Annual Partner Celebration

Union Home Mortgage unveils AI and automation advancements during 2026 Annual Partner Celebration

PR Newswire

STRONGSVILLE, Ohio, Oct. 23, 2026

The mortgage lender continues to make major technology investments going into 2027

STRONGSVILLE, Ohio, Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Union Home Mortgage (UHM), a high-growth independent mortgage banking company with a world-class culture, recently unveiled an array of AI and automation-driven technological achievements during the company's 2026 Annual Partner Celebration held Oct. 16-17 in Cleveland, Ohio. This world-class event brought over 850 UHM employees, known internally as Partners, together to highlight the lender's year-to-date business results, set goals to multiply business success, and foster connection between colleagues. Most notably, technology took center stage, highlighting advancements made in 2026 and a sneak peek at what is coming next.

Attendees were given an inside look at the next phase of technology shaping the business, with demonstrations of both newly implemented tools and future-focused prototypes. These innovations, ranging from conversational voice agents for enhanced customer support to the elimination of tedious manual document review, showcased the transformative potential of technology and underscored the lender's ongoing investment in smarter, more efficient workflows.

"What makes this event so meaningful is the chance to celebrate our Partners and the impact they have on our business and culture," said Bill Cosgrove, CEO of Union Home Mortgage. "By creating opportunities for open dialogue and idea-sharing, we're able to strengthen our culture and identify new ways to move our business forward. As we look ahead to 2027, we remain focused on our 3X initiative, empowering our Partners with the resources, technology, and support they need to achieve more while continuing to deliver a world-class experience for our borrowers. Technology will be the key to UHM's future, and I can't wait to see what new solutions are developed in time for our next Annual Partner Celebration."

While this year's Annual Partner Celebration was heavily focused on technology, the event also featured senior leadership across all departments and business channels taking the stage to share updates on critical areas such as sales performance, servicing, benefits, employee recognition, and more. UHM Partners also took part in a panel discussion and Q&A with CEO Bill Cosgrove and Sr. Vice President of Business Development Al Blank. In addition to those attending in-person, the rest of the mortgage lender's 2,300 Partners streamed the event virtually across the country. Following the event, attendees were invited to attend a celebratory carnival featuring casino-style games, a golf simulator, Family Feud, a custom t-shirt press, and more – earning raffle tickets to win high-value prizes. The lender also raffled off tickets to the MLB American League Championship Series being played at Progressive Field, as Union Home Mortgage is the Official Mortgage Partner of both teams that played in the series – the Tampa Bay Rays and the Cleveland Guardians.

Throughout the week, Partners also attended individualized leadership summits specific to their department or role within the company, as well as a Hard Stops Summit aimed at examining existing hard stops in the loan process to streamline operational efficiency.

Internal loan officer coaching program Partners Coaching Partners (PCP), which pairs each participating loan officer with a high-performing mentor and an accountability partner at their production level, also held their Fall PCP Impact event on October 14-15. The group aims to equip members with the skills and knowledge to increase productivity, generate leads, finetune the origination process, improve teambuilding, and increase profit margins. Next year, the PCP program will celebrate its twentieth consecutive PCP Impact event, cementing its status as a pillar of Partner development at UHM.

About Union Home Mortgage
Union Home Mortgage Corp. (UHM) is a high-growth, full-service retail, wholesale, and consumer direct independent mortgage banking company with branches across the U.S. in 49 states + D.C. UHM is an in-house loan servicer offering world-class customer service through high touch communication & technology. A privately held family business, with a collaborative culture that stands out in the mortgage industry, UHM Partners (employees) are guided by a Code of Conduct that emphasizes respect, open communication, and accountability. All these principles translate to industry-leading customer retention and satisfaction. Some honors include being a Six-Year USA TODAY Top Workplace and a Twelve-Year Northeast Ohio Top Workplace. Learn more at www.uhm.com.

data.title: Supercar Expert Kendall Gath Discusses What to Verify Before Buying a Limited-Edition Supercar in HelloNation
data.description:
Supercar Expert Kendall Gath Discusses What to Verify Before Buying a Limited-Edition Supercar in HelloNation

Supercar Expert Kendall Gath Discusses What to Verify Before Buying a Limited-Edition Supercar in HelloNation

PR Newswire

BOYNTON BEACH, Fla., Oct. 23, 2026

The article explains how factory records, specifications, condition, maintenance, and production information can help buyers evaluate a special-edition vehicle.

BOYNTON BEACH, Fla., Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- What should buyers verify before purchasing a limited-edition supercar?

HelloNation answers that question in an article featuring insights from Supercar Expert Kendall Gath of iLusso in Boynton Beach, FL. The article explains that buyers should confirm a vehicle's identity, factory specification, history, and originality rather than relying only on a rare badge or production number.

The vehicle identification number provides a useful starting point. Buyers can compare the VIN with factory records, ownership documents, and other available materials. Vehicle documentation may also help confirm that the car genuinely belongs to the special production series being advertised.

Production details deserve careful review because limited numbers can have different meanings. A manufacturer may restrict total global production, while certain versions are even rarer within individual markets or regions. Understanding the production details helps buyers put the vehicle's scarcity into context.

Factory specification is particularly important with special-edition vehicles. Unique paint, interior materials, wheels, aerodynamic components, and performance equipment may distinguish a model from standard production cars. Buyers can compare the current vehicle with its original configuration to determine whether significant components have been changed.

Original options can create additional differences between cars from the same edition. Factory records or original order information may identify equipment selected when the car was built. Verifying original options can help buyers understand how a particular example was configured beyond its standard special-edition features.

The article also recommends reviewing service history alongside factory and ownership records. Scheduled maintenance and documented repairs provide information about how the vehicle has been cared for. A complete service history can be especially useful with exotic cars requiring specialized maintenance at specific intervals.

Mileage alone should not replace an evaluation of maintenance or vehicle condition. A rarely driven car can still need age-related work involving fluids, tires, batteries, seals, and other components. Paint, interiors, wheels, mechanical systems, and evidence of previous repairs should also be reviewed.

Modifications are another consideration when evaluating a limited-edition supercar. Aftermarket exhaust systems, wheels, suspension changes, tuning, and cosmetic alterations may affect originality. When changes are present, buyers may want to determine whether the original components remain with the vehicle.

A pre-purchase inspection can provide another source of information. A technician familiar with the manufacturer and model may identify mechanical concerns, previous repairs, or non-original components. Those findings can then be compared with available vehicle documentation and the seller's description.

Ownership history and provenance can provide further context. Buyers may review the number of previous owners, registration history, and whether records follow the car through ownership changes. For especially rare vehicles, documented connections to notable events or manufacturer history may also influence collector interest.

The article emphasizes that limited production does not make every example equally desirable. Vehicle condition, mileage, originality, maintenance, and configuration can create significant differences between cars from the same edition. A strong example combines verifiable rarity with records that support the individual vehicle's history.

Before completing a purchase, buyers can consider the car as a complete package rather than relying on its special-edition name. Confirming factory specification, original options, maintenance, and vehicle condition can provide a clearer understanding of what makes that individual example distinctive.

Buying a Limited-Edition Supercar: What to Verify First features insights from Kendall Gath, Supercar Expert of Boynton Beach, FL, in HelloNation.

Through its community-focused publications and innovative "edvertising" approach, HelloNation delivers content that informs, inspires, and spotlights the leaders making a meaningful impact in their communities.

data.description:
NORTH EAST, PA / ACCESS Newswire / October 23, 2026 / NFI Empire, a fully owned subsidiary of Newport Gold, Inc. (OTCID:NWPG), today announced that Gannon University's MakerSpace has joined Project Reborn-001 as a technology and fabrication partner. The custom vehicle build is heading to auction at The Red Bird Games in Brentwood, TN, with proceeds benefiting The Brett Boyer Foundation. The MakerSpace is using advanced 3D-printing and design capabilities to create custom trim and badging components for this one-of-one Duramax dually.

Rendering of Project REBORN #001, a one-of-one 1979 Chevrolet K30 crew cab dually built by NFI Empire.

The Build Update

Project Reborn-001 continues its transformation of a 1979 Chevrolet K30 crew cab into a modern performance powerhouse, pairing the classic square-body exterior with a contemporary GMC Sierra 3500 frame, Duramax diesel drivetrain, suspension, and amenities. Gannon University's MakerSpace is leveraging its advanced additive manufacturing capabilities to design and produce custom trim and badging pieces that either no longer exist or have never existed before. Through modern design tools and 3D-printing technology, the team is turning concepts into physical components that help complete the unique identity of Project REBORN. These contributions showcase what advanced manufacturing can accomplish on a one-of-one build while supporting the truck's path to SEMA and its live auction benefiting The Brett Boyer Foundation. Consistent progress updates will continue to be shared as the project advances.

The steering wheel emblem for Project REBORN #001, 3D-printed by Gannon University MakerSpace. The MakerSpace also used a 3D scanner to provide precise measurements to other manufacturers so custom components could be produced for the build.

"Project REBORN #001 is a great example of what can happen when creativity, technology and hands-on problem solving come together for a meaningful purpose. Through Gannon University's MakerSpace, we have the ability to take components that may no longer exist, or ideas that have never existed, and use modern design and 3D-printing technology to turn them into physical parts. Contributing custom trim and badging to this one-of-one build gives us an opportunity to showcase what advanced manufacturing can accomplish while supporting NFI Empire and, most importantly, the incredible work of The Brett Boyer Foundation. We're proud to have Gannon University's craftsmanship and innovation become part of the story of REBORN #001," said Nick Devine, Operations Manager, Gannon MakerSpace.

"Partnering with Gannon University's MakerSpace on Project Reborn-001 brings advanced manufacturing capability and local innovation that help solve challenges only a one-of-one build can present," said Justin Fried, CEO of Newport Gold, Inc. and NFI Empire. "Every component on this truck exists to amplify awareness and funding for The Brett Boyer Foundation's work against congenital heart disease and in celebration of the Down syndrome community."

What is The Brett Boyer Foundation

The Brett Boyer Foundation is a Nashville, Tennessee-based nonprofit charitable organization founded in 2017 by Ellen and Bo Boyer in loving memory of their daughter, Sadie Brett Boyer, who was diagnosed prenatally with Down syndrome and a congenital heart defect. Sadie Brett may have only lived for 7 months, but her impact has reached countless children and families, ultimately changing the medical industry by providing kids an edge and fighting chance against CHD. Congenital heart disease (CHD) is one of the most common conditions affecting infants and one that remains severely underfunded compared to other childhood illnesses. The Brett Boyer Foundation is dedicated to raising awareness and funding research aimed at advancing treatment options while providing support to families and providers navigating a CHD diagnosis. Another mission of The Brett Boyer Foundation is to celebrate the love, capability, and dignity of the Down syndrome community. 50% of babies born with Down syndrome fight CHD. Through fundraising efforts and partnerships with like-minded organizations both in the Nashville area and across the United States, the Foundation works to improve outcomes for children living with heart disease so that fewer families endure the loss the Boyers experienced.

The Brett Boyer Foundation: https://www.thebrettboyerfoundation.org/

About Gannon University MakerSpace

The Gannon University MakerSpace, located at the Center for Manufacturing and Technology in downtown Erie, Pennsylvania, is a hands-on innovation environment offering advanced capabilities in 3D printing (additive manufacturing), metal fabrication, woodworking, and electronics assembly. Designed to inspire creativity and collaboration, the MakerSpace serves students, small businesses, and community partners by providing access to cutting-edge tools and expertise that advance traditional manufacturing into a new age of technology. Learn more at https://makerspace.gannon.engineering/.

About NFI Empire

NFI Empire (NFIEmpire.com) is the wholly owned operating subsidiary of Newport Gold, Inc., a North East, Pennsylvania-based custom automotive company known for exclusive builds, high-performance vehicles, and deep technical and digital expertise across both traditional and digital automotive sectors. The Company has ceased all mining-related operations; Newport Gold is now a holding company whose operations are conducted entirely through NFI Empire. NFI Empire's stated goal is to become the first publicly traded automotive enthusiast company to integrate a brick-and-mortar business model with a proprietary technology platform.

Club Offers for Travel Enthusiasts in Germany

BERLIN, Oct. 23, 2026

BERLIN, Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Travelzoo® (NASDAQ: TZOO), the club for travel enthusiasts, announces five of many new Club Offers for Club Members in Germany.

Rigorously vetted and negotiated for us travel enthusiasts:

  • €79 PP—3 DAYS IN DRESDEN'S OLD TOWN
    Breakfast included. The Frauenkirche, Zwinger and Semperoper are just a 15-minute walk away. Perfect for a winter getaway: the sauna area on the seventh floor with views over Dresden.
      
  • €599 PP—ADVENT CRUISE TO ALSACE
    Five days on the Rhine, round trip from Mainz. Full board and drinks are included. Route highlights: the Christmas markets in Speyer, Rüdesheim and Strasbourg. Our partner is giving us travel enthusiasts a last-minute price (regularly €1099).
      
  • FROM €1399 PP—THAILAND: 2 WEEKS AT A 4-STAR RESORT WITH FLIGHTS
    Beach vacation on Karon Beach in Phuket. Club Members stay in a superior room with pool views. We've negotiated a two-hour massage plus complimentary snacks and drinks just for us travel enthusiasts.
      
  • €109 PP—MEMBER FAVORITE IN SCHWÄBISCH HALL
    One of the oldest half-timbered houses in southwestern Germany. Club Members who have stayed here call it an "absolutely beautiful hotel." This special off-season offer is half the price of a regular stay. Includes two nights, breakfast, a 3-course dinner, and a bottle of sparkling wine.
      
  • FROM €269 PP—VENICE: 4 DAYS WITH FLIGHTS
    Four-star hotel in a 16th-century palazzo. Exposed ceiling beams, walnut paneling and Murano glass chandeliers. Once the home and atelier of the sculptor Alessandro Vittoria. Less than a 10-minute walk to St. Mark's Square and the Doge's Palace.

Offers have limited inventory and are subject to availability. 

Are you a travel enthusiast? Join the club today: https://travelzoo.com

Who are we?
We, Travelzoo®, are the club for travel enthusiasts. We reach 30 million travelers. Club Members receive Club Offers negotiated and rigorously vetted by our deal experts around the globe. Our relationships with thousands of top travel companies give us access to irresistible deals. Our club and its benefits are built around the lifestyle of a modern travel enthusiast.
